# Design — #886 `mrAutoMerge`: one outcome constructor, two transports, one human gate

Implements spec.md under the ratified ruling `sdd/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/ruling` (D1–D6, 2026-09-09). Parent: #864 task 2.5, ADR-0034 L2. File: openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/design.md

## Approach

`mrAutoMerge` is a mutating write verb built on `branchProtect`'s discipline (github.mjs:263-295): classify the transport's own words into a closed `reason` vocabulary, return a fixed-key object, never throw. Two new things: the refusal comes BEFORE the transport (so `requiredReviews > 0` cannot reach a provider seam), and the outcome object is built by ONE shared pure constructor both providers import (precedent: vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.mjs).

## Deltas against archive/862/design.md:152

| archived | this slice | ruling |
|---|---|---|
| `method = 'squash'` parameter | dropped; `--squash` / `squash: true` hardcoded | D3 |
| no tier parameter | `requiredReviews = 1` added, fail-closed | D1 |

Signature: `mrAutoMerge({ project, number, requiredReviews = 1, apiBase?, token?, proxyUrl?, fetchImpl? }) -> Promise<{enabled:true,url:string|null} | {enabled:false,reason:'requires-human-approval'} | {enabled:false,reason:'unsupported'|'transport',error:string}>`

## Data flow

caller (#888 later) → mrAutoMerge({requiredReviews}); requiredReviews>0 → refused('requires-human-approval') with NO seam touched; else github: `gh(['pr','merge',String(number),'--auto','--squash','--repo',project])` / gitlab: `gitlabApiFetch(PUT projects/{enc}/merge_requests/{number}/merge, {merge_when_pipeline_succeeds:true, squash:true})`; ok → armed({url}), fail → refused(classify(text), text). All key writing happens in lib/auto-merge-outcome.mjs.

## Architecture decisions

### A1 — Shared outcome constructor, not two inline literals
Choice: new pure module `brain/scripts/vcs/lib/auto-merge-outcome.mjs` exporting `AUTO_MERGE_REASONS` (frozen), `armed({url})`, `refused({reason, error?})`. Both providers IMPORT it; neither re-exports it.
Rejected: inline literals per provider; adding to normalize.mjs.
Rationale: a shape written twice drifts once. vcs/lib/ is the proven floor for shared imported-not-re-exported helpers (uncomputable-cause.mjs:17-20) — a helper RE-EXPORTED by both providers would be read as an undeclared contract verb by verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs:120. `error` is present iff a provider spoke: the tier refusal carries none (fabricating provider text for a local decision is the reader-empty-on-failure shape).

### A2 — GitHub `url` is unconditionally `null`
Choice: GitHub arm returns `{enabled:true, url:null}` — no stdout parsing at all.
Rejected: parsing stdout (mrCreate github.mjs:593); constructing `https://github.com/{project}/pull/{number}`.
Rationale: `gh pr merge --auto` prints a human confirmation line, not a URL, so a parse yields `''` (an empty string that reads as an answer). Constructing is repoCloneUrl's recorded latent defect and violates prView's null=uncomputable rule (vcs-contract.md:34,40). #888 already holds the PR URL from mrCreate. Asymmetry (GitLab has web_url) is stated in the contract row. TDD consequence: the happy-path test drives rawSpawn(<captured stdout>,0) and asserts `url === null`, so the decision does not depend on an unverified string.

### A3 — GitLab classifies the thrown message, anchored; gitlabApiFetch untouched
Choice: catch(err) and match `err.message` with `/API failed:\s*(?:405|406)\b/` → `unsupported`; anything else → `transport`; `error` = err.message verbatim.
Rejected: attaching `err.status` in gitlab-api.mjs:65 (additive, 2 lines, but widens the slice to the shared transport of ~10 verbs for a signal the message already carries).
Rationale: `GitLab API failed: <status> (<path>)` is de-facto pinned (gitlab-api.test.mjs:68, uncomputable-cause.test.mjs:64-91, providers.test.mjs:89). The `API failed:` anchor is load-bearing, copied from uncomputable-cause.mjs:45-59: an MR whose iid is 405 produces `GitLab API failed: 500 (projects/x%2Fy/merge_requests/405/merge)`, and a bare `\b405\b` would report an outage as "this forge will never do this". Sibling precedent: gitlab.branchProtect's anchored `': 409'` (gitlab.mjs:931-934) and its false-positive test (providers.test.mjs:543). 401/403/5xx/network stay `transport` per D2.

### A4 — The refusal is the first statement, and the test spies the seam
Choice: `if (requiredReviews > 0) return refused({reason: REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL});` as the FIRST line of both implementations.
Rejected: refusing after building the request; refusing in the caller (D1 option a).
Rationale: the invariant belongs to the port, not its callers. Proof is behavioural: GitHub seam `setSpawn(() => { calls++; … })`, GitLab a counting fetchImpl; assert `calls === 0`. A counter, not a throwing seam — an exception would fail the never-throws test for the wrong reason (trap recorded at vcs.contract.test.mjs:2160-2163).

### A5 — The unsupported fixture is a recorded fixture FILE, and the only copy
Choice: `brain/scripts/vcs/fixtures/github-mrAutoMerge-unsupported.json` with `_provenance:{recorded:true, endpoint:"gh pr merge <n> --auto --squash --repo csrinaldi/brain", date}` and the verbatim stderr; loaded via existing loadFixture + assertProvenance (vcs.contract.test.mjs:50-64) into failSpawn.
Rejected: an inline string (fine for an invented 403, wrong for EVIDENCE — the repo has a recorded-vs-derived vocabulary an inline literal cannot carry).
Rationale: D2's point is that an invented pattern is green in test and inert in production. GitLab's counterpart stays inline and DERIVED (no live GitLab mirror; vcs.contract.test.mjs:16-21).
Order of work, non-negotiable: capture the live stderr FIRST (repo is allow_auto_merge:false today), write the fixture, then write the regex from the fixture's words. If the live text differs from "auto-merge is not allowed for this repository", the regex follows the capture and the design is wrong, not the capture.

### A6 — Contract assertions vs provider argv assertions
Shapes/key sets/reasons/never-throws → parameterized `MR_AUTO_MERGE_PROVIDERS` in providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs, mirroring BRANCH_PROTECT_PROVIDERS:2168-2228. Exact gh argv and GitLab path+payload → providers.test.mjs beside branchProtect's argv tests (:357-568). The file header (vcs.contract.test.mjs:6-10) already draws that line. `--repo <project>` is pinned where argv is pinned because mrCreate resolves the repo from the git remote instead (github.mjs:579).

### A7 — cli.mjs: one array entry, no flag parsing
Add `'mrAutoMerge'` to VERBS (cli.mjs:38-46), nothing else. MEASURED: the CLI takes ONE JSON blob (`args = JSON.parse(process.argv[3])`, cli.mjs:184-192), so requiredReviews arrives as a JSON key exactly as branchProtect's does — there is no `--required-reviews` to add. bindIdentity (:159-168) wraps every function export exhaustively. Free property: `node brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs mr-auto-merge '{"project":"o/r","number":1}'` REFUSES — fail-closed reaches the CLI with no extra code.

## File changes

| File | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| brain/scripts/vcs/lib/auto-merge-outcome.mjs | Create | AUTO_MERGE_REASONS, armed, refused — only writer of these keys (~30 lines) |
| brain/scripts/vcs/lib/auto-merge-outcome.test.mjs | Create | Unit + source guard: no provider source writes `enabled:` by hand |
| brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs | Modify | mrAutoMerge after mrCreate (:595) via the gh() chokepoint (:68) |
| brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs | Modify | mrAutoMerge after mrCreate (:1147), gitlabApiFetch PUT in try/catch |
| brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs | Modify | 'mrAutoMerge' in VERBS |
| brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs | Modify | MR_AUTO_MERGE_PROVIDERS block |
| brain/scripts/vcs/providers.test.mjs | Modify | argv / path+payload pins |
| brain/scripts/vcs/fixtures/github-mrAutoMerge-unsupported.json | Create | captured stderr, recorded:true |
| .../brain-drafts/vcs-contract.draft.md | Create | brain-amendment/1, two rows (agent authors) |
| brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md | Modify | verb row + adapter row — MAINTAINER's commit only |
| brain/scripts/vcs/verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs | Untouched | acceptance signal; editing it voids the gate |

## Failure classification

| provider | observed | reason | error |
|---|---|---|---|
| github | stderr matches the captured auto-merge-not-allowed class | unsupported | r.stderr.trim() |
| github | any other non-zero exit, ENOENT launch failure (exec.mjs:30-32) | transport | r.stderr.trim() or `gh pr merge failed (status N)` |
| gitlab | /API failed:\s*(?:405\|406)\b/ | unsupported | err.message |
| gitlab | 401, 403, 5xx, fetch failed, anything else | transport | err.message |
| both | requiredReviews > 0 | requires-human-approval | absent |

Pinned key sets: ['enabled','url'] armed · ['enabled','reason'] tier refusal · ['enabled','error','reason'] unsupported/transport.

## Testing strategy — STRICT TDD (red first, in order)

1. unit: armed/refused key sets + frozen vocabulary (lib/auto-merge-outcome.test.mjs)
2. contract: omitted requiredReviews refuses; requiredReviews:1 refuses with seam calls === 0 (both providers)
3. contract: armed → {enabled:true,url}; url null on github / web_url on gitlab; key set pinned
4. contract: unsupported (github: the recorded fixture; gitlab: 405 and 406)
5. contract: transport (5xx, 401, network text); error is a string
6. contract: never throws on every path (doesNotReject); reason ∈ AUTO_MERGE_REASONS
7. regression: gitlab 500 on iid 405 is transport, not unsupported (A3)
8. provider: github argv exactly `pr merge <n> --auto --squash --repo <project>`; gitlab path + {merge_when_pipeline_succeeds:true,squash:true}
9. acceptance: verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs unmodified, all three checks

Commands: `node --test brain/scripts/vcs/lib/auto-merge-outcome.test.mjs`; `node --test brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs`; `node --test brain/scripts/vcs/providers.test.mjs`; `node --test brain/scripts/vcs/verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs` (RED until the promotion commit); `npm test` before handing over. No network, no real spawn: GitHub via setSpawn (lib/exec.mjs:11), GitLab via injected fetchImpl.

## D5 — the doc row, the draft, the commit order

Draft: openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/brain-drafts/vcs-contract.draft.md, a brain-amendment/1 NON-ADR amendment (no `amendment:`/`home-summary:` — ADR-only, a hard parse error here, amendment-draft.mjs:147-154). Contract block: `target: brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md`, `issue: 886`. Two amend-find/amend-replace pairs, each anchoring a whole unique line: (1) the `| \`mrCreate\` | … |` Required verbs row (vcs-contract.md:33) → itself + the new mrAutoMerge row (guard regex `^\|\s*\`([a-zA-Z]+)\`\s*\|`, verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs:68 — backticked, alphabetic); (2) the `| \`mrCreate\` | implemented | implemented (A3 — issue #239) |` Phase 3 adapter row (:99) → itself + the mrAutoMerge adapter row.

Verification before handover (brain:promote has NO dry-run — it refuses every option and gates on a typed word, brain-promote.mjs:123-133):

```
node --input-type=module -e "
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { planAmendment } from './brain/scripts/lib/amendment-draft.mjs';
const r = planAmendment({
  draftText: readFileSync('openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/brain-drafts/vcs-contract.draft.md','utf8'),
  targetText: readFileSync('brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md','utf8'),
  homeText: null, gitUserName: 'draft-check', today: '2026-09-09', issueFallback: '886',
});
console.log(r.ok ? (r.plan ? r.plan.acts.map(a=>a.act+':'+a.state).join(' ') + ' | ' + r.plan.commitSubject : 'ALREADY APPLIED') : r.error);
"
```
Expected: `2:pending 2:pending | docs(brain): amend brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md (#886)`. Anything else (blocked/partial) means an anchor moved: re-anchor, never hand-edit the target.

Commit order, forced: the guard is bidirectional (:82 VERBS ⊆ doc ∪ allowlist; :74 doc ⊆ VERBS; :120 shared provider exports ⊆ VERBS). Implementing in both providers already fires :120, so code cannot split from VERBS and VERBS cannot split from the doc row. THERE IS NO GREEN ORDERING BEFORE THE PROMOTION COMMIT. Therefore: (1) agent commits tests + lib/ + both providers + VERBS + fixture + draft → CI RED on check :82 by design; (2) maintainer runs `npm run brain:promote -- openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/brain-drafts/vcs-contract.draft.md` ON THIS BRANCH and commits the target edit (an agent may not commit brain/core/**); (3) CI green, cold review, merge. The red interval IS the feature. Do not allowlist the verb in DOCUMENTED_BUT_NOT_REQUIRED (:33).

## Changed-line estimate

brain.config.json:18-29 excludes **/*.test.mjs and openspec/changes/** from diff-size-count.mjs. Counted: lib/auto-merge-outcome.mjs ~30, github.mjs ~40, gitlab.mjs ~45, cli.mjs ~1, fixture ~10, vcs-contract.md (promotion commit) ~4 → ~130 counted, Low risk. Uncounted but reviewer-visible: tests ~180, draft ~45 → ~225. ONE PR, no chaining. Review order: outcome module → refusal branch → each provider's classifier → draft.

## Migration / rollout

None. No config key, no state, no caller, no repository setting changed (allow_auto_merge stays false; enabling is #805's gate). Rollback = git revert of the PR.

## Risks and residuals

- The captured stderr class is narrower/wider than the live text → A5's order (capture, then regex); fixture carries recorded:true.
- GitHub url is always null — asymmetry a caller could read as failure → stated in the contract row, asserted by a named test; enabled:true is the success signal.
- IMMEDIATE MERGE when the target branch has no required context — `--auto` and merge_when_pipeline_succeeds both degrade to "merge now". Out of scope by D6; #889's lane-paths/lane-scrub are the precondition. Recorded so #888 does not arm on an unguarded branch.
- A caller reads enabled:true as "merged" → the word "armed" is in the contract row, the test name and #888's handoff.
- The branch sits red until the promotion commit → by design (D5).
- vcs-contract.md:85 says "the 21 verbs" while VERBS already has 25 → pre-existing drift, NOT fixed here (would widen the amendment beyond the two ruled rows). Filed for a later doc amendment.

## Open questions

None blocking. The two live captures (GitHub's unsupported stderr, and the success line) are TDD-time measurements by construction — A2 and A5 are written so neither capture can invalidate the design.
